items.title: Mr. and Mrs. A.C. Synigal Interview, 1962-05-24
items.q: It's Helen Thornton. Miss Thornton. And he's your friend. Yeah. He is, uh, her husband is a retired principal... This is myself, and this is my daughter-in-law... these are all prominent colored people.

ctx.x: Here, we've got you upside down. I've seen it before. I don't know who she's talking about.

It's Helen Thornton. Miss Thornton. And he's your friend. Yeah. He is, uh, her husband is a retired principal, not a school teacher. He's a retired principal. And here is, you know her, Mrs. What? What's her name? Druggist. Oh, yeah. Druggist man. Huh? Thornton. No, you said Mrs. Thornton, but the other lady, Alma what? What's her name? And as Mrs. Brown. A drugstore, on a drugstore uptown. And as Mrs. Benergy Brown. This is myself, and this is my daughter-in-law, and her husband. And, uh, well this is the group…
That's another. I think we just looked at this one. Yeah, you looked at this one? We're going the other way. Oh, we're going the other way.
